meta.title: Thirty-Six Windows on Consciousness
meta.subtitle: Learning Sanskrit by Taking the Words Apart
meta.blurb: Thirty-six Trika statements dismantled until every letter, case ending, compound, verb and sandhi makes sense — then you can decide what the ancient authors mean without asking a translation to do the thinking.
meta.back_cover: No invented Sanskrit. No mystical etymologies passed off as grammar. No need to believe the translation before understanding the language. Thirty-six short statements from the Śiva Sūtras, Abhinavagupta, Utpaladeva and the Spanda tradition — taken apart, proved, and left in your hands.
